freeze_stage: Review and freeze before computing prediction vectors; freeze vectors before opening target numerical columns

prediction_fit.training_gene_filter: mean normalized count across33 order<=2 libraries >=10
prediction_fit.CODE2_models: Exact hash-pinned predict_all and training_state functions; no refit on triples

extra_models.all_triples_mean: Mean of four unlocked triple cell means
extra_models.quiet_triples_mean: Mean of PQ-HL-HS and S-PQ-HL cell means, selected after prior discovery
extra_models.quiet_common_rank2: CT + orthogonal rank2 projection of quiet_triples_mean-CT
extra_models.quiet_residual_rank2: CT + complement of orthogonal rank2 projection of quiet_triples_mean-CT
extra_models.cubic_factorial: Sum of triples - sum of pairs + sum of singles - CT; degree<=3 factorial extension

primary_geometry.gene_universe: all_filtered; 21495 genes in unchanged source order
primary_geometry.basis: Exact CODE2 SVD of11 lower-order cell means minus CT, unscaled log expression, no grand centering
primary_geometry.responsive_panel: Ordinary expression metrics only; no restricted or QR basis

evaluation.gain_definition: baseline error minus candidate error per same pooled library
evaluation.uncertainty_reporting: Three separate pooled libraries and min/mean/max; no genes-as-replicates inference
evaluation.target_read: Explicit separate evaluation command after protocol, code, inputs and prediction NPZ hashes frozen

program_matching.mean_variable: Training mean normalized count over33 order<=2 libraries
program_matching.variance_variable: Within-condition pooled variance after projecting each library into rank2 residual space
program_matching.matching: Exact per-program gene counts in each joint bin; no outcome use
program_matching.infeasibility: If any required bin has fewer background genes than requested, report diagnostic INFEASIBLE; no adaptive bin relaxation
program_matching.interpretation: Descriptive matched-reference specificity, not independent biological replication
program_matching.sampling: Exclude target-program genes; without replacement within each draw; same frozen draws for every condition and target
program_matching.null_limit: Joint matching does not preserve biological coexpression or GO overlap; empirical percentiles descriptive, not P-values

limitations: One internal held-out factorial cell with three biological pooled RNA libraries; not external replication
The quiet triple definitions were selected after viewing discovery triples
Processed source normalization may have used all48 libraries, including target columns
Published qualitative four-way findings were already known; numerical outcome holdout is not fully hypothesis-blind
Large pools of seedlings do not increase biological n beyond three libraries per cell
No mechanism, memory, hysteresis or phase-transition inference from this single endpoint
All16 models and predeclared program scenarios must be reported; no post-target model tuning
outcome_opening_gate: Parent explicitly authorizes target numerical read only after reviewing frozen prediction and program manifests

program_definition.membership: All15 unchanged CODE2 GO sets; >=10 filtered genes; all retained in catalog
program_definition.score: Project EACH library before equal-weight program means; raw, common and residual effects versus CT
program_definition.uncertainty: Biological-pool SE conditional on fixed basis; preserve shared-control covariance; leave-one-pool range is not a confidence interval
program_definition.quiet_comparison: Full15-program profile cosine descriptive; direct quiet1-minus-quiet2 contrasts cancel CT for fixed basis
program_definition.target_comparison: Frozen15-program target residual profile versus quiet-pair centroid; no selected subsets or refit
program_definition.ratio: Residual/raw RMS can exceed1 for a program; never label explained-variance fraction
program_definition.dependency: GO residual score depends on genes outside the set via the global projector; not pathway activity

dataset_decision: Retain same dataset regardless of predictor outcome.
